description: Inside a transitive ZFC-model with internal ccc, the deciding antichains can be selected as one ground-model sequence; its positive-row nice name and code belong to the model. The internal nice-code set and its enumeration exist there, and the displayed evaluation and composite names belong there by Replacement. Internal ccc and the countable-row calculation give the ground-model bound \(|\mathcal C|\le\kappa^{\aleph_0}\).
